rationale: Both circuits belong to the same Ramsey sequence family and differ only in wait length (Gw)^k; the researcher-approved decision marks every pair of this family scientifically compatible.
empirical_test: offset test (fit windows 1-29, held-out 30-48): train chi2/df=78.1 (p=0.0e+00), held-out chi2/df=247.2 (p=0.0e+00); transitions |z|>2: 28%
